description: Source code for the ST Microelectronics LIS2DW12 3-axis accelerometer driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, configuration, data fetching, and register manipulation functions.

methods.name: lis2dw12_set_range
methods.description: Sets the accelerometer's full scale range (2, 4, 8, 16 G).

methods.name: lis2dw12_set_odr
methods.description: Sets the output data rate for the accelerometer.

methods.name: lis2dw12_convert
methods.description: Converts raw accelerometer data to sensor_value in m/s^2.

methods.name: lis2dw12_channel_get_acc
methods.description: Retrieves acceleration data for specified axis.

methods.name: lis2dw12_channel_get
methods.description: Gets acceleration data for a specified sensor channel.

methods.name: lis2dw12_config
methods.description: Configures sensor attributes like full scale and sampling frequency.

methods.name: sensor_ms2_to_mg
methods.description: Converts sensor_value in m/s^2 to milli-g units.

methods.name: lis2dw12_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes based on attribute type.

methods.name: lis2dw12_init
methods.description: Initializes the LIS2DW12 device, performs ID check, resets, and configures settings.
